Siddanth Shaiva

AI Engineer - Machine Learning Engineer - Generative AI Specialist

Bengaluru, India. +91-7795110357 notifier.tester12@gmail.com linkedin.com/in/Siddanth Shaiva https://github.com/Siddanthshaiva

Summary

AI Engineer with 6+ years of experience in NLP, Computer Vision, and Generative AI, specializing in LLMs, RAG, and multi-agent AI systems for enterprise automation. Delivered UAE based AI projects (Exalogic,

AL-HAMRA, American University of Sharjah PoC) and Govt. of India, BHASHINI, showcasing AI Governance that impacting over 1M daily users. Skilled in Azure AI and GCP deployments, driving cost reduction, workflow automation, and improved customer experiences.

Core Technical Skills

AI/ML Frameworks : PyTorch, Keras, TensorFlow, Nvidia Triton serving, HuggingFace, LangChain, LangGraph, LLaMA-Index

NLP and Generative AI: Transformers, GPT, BERT, RAG, OCR, NER, Summarization, Model Evaluations, training, Prompt Engineering, Fine-tuning (LoRA, Q-LoRA), AI Ethics

Computer Vision: YOLO, Deep Learning, CNN, Object detection, Image Classification, Layout Detection, Document AI

Cloud and DevOps: Azure (OpenAI, AI Search), GCP (AI/ML), Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, MLOps

Programming and Tools: Python, FastAPI, Flask, GitHub, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, Linux

Professional Experience (6+ years)

Freelancing/Consulting	Jun 2025 – Sep 2025

AI Lead	Bengaluru, India

Led a team of 5 engineers to design, develop and monitor the system of AI agents for sales automation, improving

lead capture by 21%

Built multi-agent AI systems using LangGraph for lead analysis and engagement insights, enhancing CRM efficiency

Developed a voice-enabled chatbot for ERP/HR analytics, streamlining decisions by 15%

Exalogic Consulting	Nov 2024 – Apr 2025

AI/ML  Developer	Bengaluru, India

Developed a LangGraph based AI agent(RAG and tools), improving query accuracy and reducing processing time by 70% (client - AL-HAMRA)

Automated HR workflows with AI agents, reducing manual effort by 35%

Prototyped(PoC) a multilingual RAG chatbot using Azure AI Search, validating scalability for 10K+ students for

American University of Sharjah and highlighting AI Ethics and Responsible AI

Optimized the RAG pipeline for knowledge management systems, improving information retrieval through

advanced embedding and chunking techniques within organization(Exalogic Consulting).

Tarento Technologies	Apr 2021 – Oct 2024

AI Engineer	Bengaluru, India

Fine-tuned OCR and layout detection models for Indic languages, cutting processing time by 40%

Built a multilingual subtitle generation pipeline using text detection and translation models.

Delivered secure authentication and MFA services at scale for enterprise users.

Developed and delivered secure model benchmarking and evaluation pipeline used by 1M+ daily users

Enhanced Data and RAG pipeline, improving retrieval quality for enterprise knowledge management



ByTech India	Jun 2019 – Apr 2021

Machine Learning Engineer	Bengaluru,India

Built a mobile document scanner with advanced image enhancement (skew and blur correction).

Developed invoice layout detection model, reducing manual data entry by 40%

Implemented object detection for warehouse automation cutting labeling effort by 30%

Key Projects

RealCube Estate (Exalogic Consulting, UAE/Bengaluru): Led development of RAG-based multimodal

AI agent, automating 92% of property support tasks

American University of Sharjah (PoC): Prototyped a multilingual RAG chatbot on Azure AI Search, validating scalability for 10K+ students.

AL-HAMRA (Dubai): Developed a LangGraph based AI agent(RAG and tools), improving query accuracy

and reducing processing time by 70%

ULCA/BHASHINI (Govt. of India): Developed and delivered secure model benchmarking and evaluation pipeline used by 1M+ daily users.

ANUVAAD (EkStep):Fine-tuned OCR and translation models, boosting accuracy by 15%

Achievements

Awarded by Govt. of India for contributions to ULCA, an AI system serving 1M+ users daily

Recognized by Exalogic (Dubai) for RAG-based customer support automation (AL-HAMRA).

Delivered AI solutions across enterprise and government projects, improving efficiency and adoption at scale

Education

Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) - Computer/Information Engineering: Adichunchanagiri Institute of Technology, Karnataka: 2014 - 2018
